maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is insurance premiums for commercial liability, workers' comp, title and surety coverage, not repair or servicing of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums come mainly from private businesses, contractors and property buyers; public entities are only one customer segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through underwriting and its own decentralized operating companies, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Specialty insurance, workers' comp, surety and title coverage are regulation- or contract-required; switching means underwriting, collateral and claims disruption.

notes: Also has a title insurance business, which is a large part of the company.
